field.label: Remote upstreams
field.help: Upstreams for proxy domains, comma separated. tcp://, tls:// and https:// (DoH) are supported.

field.label: SOCKS5 proxy
field.help: Optional SOCKS5 proxy (host:port) used for remote upstreams. Empty means direct.

field.label: Local upstreams
field.help: Upstreams for direct (domestic) domains, comma separated.

field.label: Direct domain files
field.help: Domain list files resolved via local upstreams, comma separated.

field.label: Proxy domain files
field.help: Domain list files resolved via remote upstreams, comma separated.

field.label: Block domain files
field.help: Domain list files to block (NXDOMAIN), comma separated.
